description: Java class 'ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo' which models and gathers metadata about a UI screen component within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to populate relationships with entities, services, forms, and controller requests used in the screen, along with getter methods for related artifacts and display information.

classes.name: ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata about a screen widget including its dependencies on entities, services, forms, and controller requests. Capable of populating its associations by analyzing the screen model and providing related artifact information.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates internal relationships with entities, services, forms, and linked requests based on the model screen analysis.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service artifacts used in the screen from a set of service names, verifying existence and updating references.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity artifacts used in the screen from a set of entity names, validating names, and updating references.

methods.name: populateFormsFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds form widget artifacts included in the screen from a set of form names, validating existence and updating references.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Links to controller request artifacts based on request identifiers, handling URL parts and updating reverse references.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display name for the screen, stripping system prefixes.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the string 'Screen Widget' as the type description.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type ID for this artifact info type.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier string combining location and screen name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves the location into a URL object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on model screen name and source location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the string representation.

methods.name: getViewsReferringToScreen
methods.description: Retrieves view artifacts that refer to this screen.

methods.name: getEntitiesUsedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of entities utilized by this screen.

methods.name: getServicesUsedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of services utilized by this screen.

methods.name: getFormsIncludedInScreen
methods.description: Returns the set of forms included in this screen.

methods.name: getScreensIncludedInScreen
methods.description: Placeholder returning an empty set; intended to return included screens.

methods.name: getScreensIncludingThisScreen
methods.description: Returns screens that include this screen.

methods.name: getRequestsLinkedToInScreen
methods.description: Returns controller requests linked to this screen.
